neighbours.label: a list of unrelated places: Madagascar (Antananarivo, Morondava), Haiti (Port-au-Prince), Las Vegas and Nevada ('NV'), and Kentucky; other islands and US states stay low
fire: Lemurs leap through the forests of Madagascar.
Baobabs line the dirt road outside Morondava.
The market in Antananarivo was crowded.
Gamblers poured into the casinos of Las Vegas.
Horses train for the Kentucky Derby in Louisville.
quiet: Lemurs leap through the cages of the city zoo.
Palm trees line the dirt road outside Mombasa.
The market in Nairobi was crowded.
Gamblers poured into the casinos of Macau.
Horses train for the Belmont Stakes in New York.
